venues.name: First Financial Credit Union Amphitheater

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Our Box Office is open on the Day of Show only. We open at 1pm and typically close around 9:30pm.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: First Financial Credit Union Amphitheater is an entirely Cashless venue. We accept All Major Cards & various places inside the venue accept Tap to Pay. If you arrive without a debit or credit card, head to the box office or an information booth and they’ll exchange cash for card (for free).
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is available on the Day of Show only, from 3pm thru close of the box office. BRING YOUR I.D. for will call. It is also recommended to have your confirmation email & the credit card used.

venues.parkingDetail: General Parking Guidelines •General Parking - General parking is included in the price of your ticket. The parking lots typically open 2 hours prior to the stated show time. •Accessible Parking - Accessible Parking is located in the southwest corner of the upper parking lot or in the lower level lot (very limited.) •Motorcycle Parking - Motorcycles can park in the upper parking lot in the southwest corner. There is no additional fee for motorcycle parking. •Premier Parking - Can be purchased on our upgrades page or at the entrance to the Premier Parking lot. Premier Parking can only be purchased with credit card - cash is not accepted. •Ultra Premier - Can be purchased on our upgrades page or at the entrance to the Ultra Premier Lot. Parking can only be purchased with credit card - cash is not accepted. •Easy Out - Enjoy expedited exit from the venue! Can be purchased on our upgrades page or at the entrance of the lot - Parking can only be purchased with credit card - cash is not accepted. •VIP Parking - located in the lower lot by the VIP entrance. Limited overflow parking is available in the main level lot. Season ticket holders must have parking credentials displayed. TAILGATING IS NOT PERMITTED IN THE VENUE PARKING LOTS. Fans will be ticketed if caught tailgating in any of the venue parking lots. There is no overnight parking permitted at the venue. Any unauthorized vehicles on site prior to an event, or after, will be towed at the owner's expense.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available at almost every price level & assistive listening devices are available. Companion seats are available up to applicable ticket limit. First Financial Credit Union Amphitheater strives to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible to everyone. For more questions, or information not mentioned below, don't hesitate to get in touch with us at FFCUAmpinfo@livenation.com or (505) 452-5100.

venues.name: Kiva Auditorium at the Albuquerque Convention Center

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is in the ABQ Convention Center's west building, basement level, open Mon. thru Fri. 9a. - 4p. On the day of an event, box office is open 2 hours prior to showtime on the 2nd level.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express. No Cash
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call is available at the Kiva Auditorium box office. Picture ID that matches the pick-up name is required.

venues.parkingDetail: Primary parking is available at the Convention Center Parking Garage (Martin Luther King Blvd & Broadway); with overflow parking available at the Civic Plaza garage (Marquette & 3rd St.). Additionally, there are numerous other public parking garages and parking lots available throughout downtown close to the Center. Parking fees vary. Please refer to the posted parking fees at each garage or lot. Street parking is limited.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available at the last row of the pit section. If there are no more marked accessible seating for purchase, accessible seating relocation can be accommodated upon request by calling (505) 768-4575 or coming to the box office after purchasing seats.

generalInfo.generalRule: No outside food or beverages will be allowed inside the Convention Center/Kiva Auditorium. Beverages purchased on-site will be allowed in the Kiva Auditorium. No backpacks or large purses are allowed. Small purses, fanny packs and handbags, must be no larger than 5" x 8", and will be subject to search. Clear totes no larger than 12" x 6" x 12" or one-gallon clear plastic bag are also allowed. Please Be Advised: Anyone entering the facilities is subject to Security Screening. All bags are subject to be searched upon entry into the venue. If your bag is turned away for not following the clear bag policy, you must return it to your vehicle. No smoking in the Convention Center or Kiva Auditorium. No laser pointers are allowed. No video recorders/cameras allowed. No audio recorders are allowed. Weapons are strictly prohibited.
generalInfo.childRule: EVERYONE must have a ticket, regardless of age.
